# WavDecoder

[DotGame.AudioCodecs](README.md) · `DotGame.AudioCodecs.Wav` · class

```csharp
public sealed class WavDecoder : AudioDecoder
```

Types: [`AudioDecoder`](AudioDecoder.md)

Decodes WAV files: 8, 16, 24 and 32-bit integer and 32 and 64-bit float samples, 1 to 8 channels, in the plain and WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE forms.

## Remarks

Chunks other than `fmt ` and `data` are skipped. A file whose `data` chunk is longer than the file is an `InvalidDataException`, as is one that ends early; a data size of 0xFFFFFFFF (a stream written without its length) means the samples run to the end.

## Constructors

```csharp
public WavDecoder(Stream stream, bool leaveOpen = false)
```

Opens `stream`, from its current position, as a WAV file.

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `stream` | The file. A stream that can't seek can be read but not seeked. |
| `leaveOpen` | Whether disposing the decoder leaves `stream` open. |

**Throws `InvalidDataException`:** The data isn't a WAV file this decoder reads, or is damaged.

```csharp
public WavDecoder(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> data)
```

Opens `data` as a WAV file, read in place.

**Throws `InvalidDataException`:** The data isn't a WAV file this decoder reads, or is damaged.
